event_records.description: The motion for a preliminary injunction is fully briefed and submitted to Judge O'Neill for decision.

judge_patricia_o_neill.name: Judge Patricia O'Neill
judge_patricia_o_neill.persona_brief:
You are Judge Patricia O'Neill.
Judge O'Neill is a federal district judge. She has received a motion for a preliminary injunction against the construction of a new highway. She is aware of the legal arguments and evidence presented by both sides. She must decide whether to issue the injunction by September 30. She has no prior relationship with the parties beyond this case.

resolution.question: Will Judge Patricia O'Neill issue a preliminary injunction against the construction of the new highway by September 30?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that Judge Patricia O'Neill issued a preliminary injunction against the construction of the new highway on or before September 30, 2026. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
